# News App NoSQL Schema

The document defines the data schema for Firebase Firestore.

## 1. Articles

Stores articles created by users. This collection holds the information of the articles to be displayed in the feed of the app.

### Path
- `/articles/{articleUid}`

**articleUid:** UID generated by Firestore.

**Fields: (temporary until I define new features)**
    * `articleUid` (string) [Required]: UID generated by Firestore.
    * `title` (string) [Required]: 3–120 chars. The headline of the article.
    * `description` (string) [Required]: 90–250 chars. Summary for list view.
    * `content` (string) [Required]: 100–20,000 chars. The full body of the article.
    * `category` (string) [Required]: Must perfectly match one of: [business, entertainment, general, health, science, sport, technology].
    * `status` (string) [Required]: Must perfectly match one of: [draft, published, archived].
    * `thumbnailPath` (string) [Required]: Path for the thumbnail image in Firebase Storage.
        *Cloud Storage Path:* `media/articles/{articleId}/thumbnail.jpg`
    * `authorUid` (string) [Required]: Firebase Auth UID length (usually 28 chars).
    * `authorName` (string) [Required]: 2–50 chars. Author's name.
    * `createdAt` (timestamp) [Required]: Creation date. Should be set to the current date and time upon creation.
    * `publishedAt` (timestamp) [Optional]: Publish date (used for sorting feed).
    * `updatedAt` (timestamp) [Required]: Last update date (used for caching). Should be updated every time a write occurs to the document.
    * `viewsCount` (int) [Required]: Must be >= 0. Should default to 0 upon creation. Amount of views the article has.

**Example:**

```json
{
  "articleUid": "h7Gk92fLp0",
  "title": "Flutter vs. Native: The 2026 Verdict",
  "description": "An in-depth look at the performance benchmarks...",
  "content": "Full body text here...",
  "category": "technology",
  "status": "published",
  "thumbnailPath": "media/articles/h7Gk92fLp0/thumbnail.jpg",
  "authorUid": "user_123",
  "authorName": "Jane Doe",
  "createdAt": "2026-04-09T10:00:00Z",
  "publishedAt": "2026-04-09T12:00:00Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-04-09T12:00:00Z",
  "viewsCount": 42
}
```

## 2. Storage Rules Reference
Images are strictly hosted in the `media/articles/{articleUid}` folder to enforce security rules (users can only write to their own folder).
